intro.text: Lunamor's second daughter, named after a kind of shell from the Horneater Peaks.

items.text: Kuma'tiki travelled for months with her family to join Lunamor on the Shattered Plains. When Voidbringers attacked their caravan, the family held out behind a pile of furniture until Bridge Four found them on patrol and brought them to Urithiru, where she helped her father serve food and drink to the bridgemen.
Soon after the people of Hearthstone were evacuated, Kuma'tiki went back to the Peaks with most of her family; only Cord and Gift stayed behind.
